name: Skill library
description: A collection of reusable factory workflows, each packaged with its own trigger conditions, instructions, references, and supporting resources.
readme:
# Skill library

Reusable skills built from `_templates/skill` per the `CHARTER.md`. One folder per skill.

- Cross-app skills live here.
- Project-specific skills may live with their app instead.

The four running tools (`wireframing`, `skill-optimizer`, `ux-audit`, `tester`) live
under `/agents` because they are agents; pure skills land here.
